fee_notes: Royalty: 8% of gross receipts weekly (4% for first 6 months of new centers). Marketing: $1,200 weekly (~$5,200 monthly, can increase max 10%/year after year 1, no weekly cap). Software license: $799-$973/month (CCC One Base Package). Fleet Addendum reduces marketing to $350/week. Development Incentive Addendum: 1-2-2% royalty tiered over 36 months (subject to $1.1M gross receipt threshold).
